topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the administrative opening and learning objectives for the cancer therapy lecture.

topics.label: Conventional interventions, cytotoxic chemotherapy, and resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine standard non-targeted cancer interventions including surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy, alongside the physiological side effects and drug efflux mechanisms that limit them.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic vulnerabilities, checkpoint defects, and synthetic lethality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe therapeutic strategies designed to exploit inherent cancer-specific defects, including hormone signaling dependence, cell cycle checkpoint alterations, oncolytic viral sensitivity, and DNA repair deficiencies.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors, oncogene addiction, and pathway resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on small-molecule inhibitors of hyperactivated oncogenic kinases and the molecular resistance, bypass signaling, and drug addiction phenomena that emerge during treatment.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibody therapies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address targeted therapies that utilise engineered monoclonal antibodies to block receptor signalling, direct immune-mediated cell lysis, or selectively deliver cytotoxic payloads to tumor cells.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and immune-based interventions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological basis and clinical implementation of cancer immunotherapies, including immune surveillance evidence, checkpoint blockade, bispecific T-cell engagers, and CAR T-cell engineering.

topics.label: Therapeutic challenges, clinical progress, and future directions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the overarching challenges in oncology, historical trends in cancer survival and prevention, emerging therapeutic paradigms, and the ethical dilemmas of clinical drug trials.
